description: What changed on one offer, newest first: its changelog events (listed, verified, terms_updated, expired, incidents, …) and edits to its public facts (what is free, limits, card rule, expiry, vendor URL), each with a { from, to } diff when fields changed. Same data and paging as GET /api/v1/offers/{slug}/history.
